functions.purpose: XMC VADC sample-and-hold startup calibration: enable SHS cal bits, kick 9 SHS steps per outer loop, wait on status MSB, then clear BRS/CHCTR.

Start background request source / BRSCTRL run bit

Nine SHS calibration steps per outer iteration
SHS/VADC calibration kick bit written to RAM-held register

functions.purpose: Ungate VADC clock via SCU PASSWD/CGATCLR0, program GLOBCFG and both VADC groups (queue, CHCTR, class), run SHS calibration, then enable NVIC IRQ 19 (VADC0_G0). Two mux layouts keyed off RAM flag 0x200025cc.

immediates.meaning: VADC QMR0 bit 26 (flush/gate) after QCTRL write
SHS step/timing config written before calibration
NVIC IRQ 19 = VADC0_G0 (priority 3 then ISER enable)

functions.purpose: CMSIS-style NVIC_EnableIRQ: if irqNumber >= 0, write 1<<(irq&31) to NVIC ISER (0xE000E100). Used by VADC init.

immediates.meaning: Skip NVIC ISER for negative (system-handler) IRQn
ISER set-enable bit before shift by irq index

functions.purpose: CMSIS NVIC_SetPriority: 2-bit priority in bits 7:6 of the IPR/SHPR byte. Peripheral IRQs via NVIC IPR 0xE000E400; negative IRQn via SCB SHPR 0xE000ED00+0x1C.

immediates.meaning: Full priority byte mask before shift into IPR word
SCB SHPR2 offset from SCB base

functions.purpose: Ungate CCU8, configure four CCU80 slices (INS/CMC/TC/PR/CR/CR2) from RAM timing, enable CCU80_0/1 IRQs 25–26, start timers via GIDLC/GCSS, map P0.0–P0.3/P0.8–P0.9 to CCU8 ALT5/ALT7.

immediates.meaning: CCU8 slice TC extra timer-control bits
PORT0 IOCR PCx 0xA8 = push-pull ALT5 (CCU8 PWM)

functions.purpose: Second compilation-unit copy of NVIC_EnableIRQ (ISER 0xE000E100). Used by CCU8 PWM init for IRQs 25 and 26.

immediates.meaning: Skip NVIC ISER for negative IRQn
ISER set-enable bit before shift by irq index

functions.purpose: Ungate CCU4, program four CCU40 slices (period/compare/prescaler), P1.3 ALT2, set CCU40_0 IRQ 21 priority 0x80, clear pending and enable ISER, then GIDLC/GCSS start.

immediates.meaning: NVIC IPR5 byte for IRQ 21 (CCU40_0) priority 0x80
1<<21 written to ICPR then ISER for CCU40_0

functions.purpose: Program PORT1 IOCR (P1.0–1 pulldown in, P1.2/4/5 push-pull out) and PORT0 IOCR (PWM pins tristate until CCU8 maps them; P0.4/5/10/12/13 pull-up in). Wait until P0.12 reads high.

immediates.meaning: PORT1 IOCR0 P1.2 = 0x80 push-pull GPIO output
Spin while PORT0.IN bit 12 (P0.12) is still low

functions.purpose: Active-low sample of PORT0.IN bit 10 (P0.10): returns 1 if pin is grounded, 0 if high. Raw input for DebounceDigitalInput.
